anmolkapil/plexo.creator: marc.kaz
anmolkapil/plexo.caption:
🚨 MERGE EVERY INTERNET CONNECTION INTO ONE DOWNLOAD

Plexo is a download manager that splits one file across Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and a tethered phone at the same time.

Ships with:
• Parallel streams on every network you own
• Direct downloads and torrents
• Live per-network speed charts
• Speed caps,

nandhakishorm/laya.creator: marc.kaz
nandhakishorm/laya.caption:
🚨 A LOCAL 421M MODEL JUST ATE CLOUD JEV ON SPEED

Laya is an open-source System 1 decision model that runs on your machine. 

Laya: 86.5 decisions/sec, P50 ~9ms, score 46
Jev: 3.2 decisions/sec, 317ms API round-trip, score 1

Ships with:
• 421M params, ~1GB inference memory
• Millisecond local calls
